threads.body: [Config] On `maintenance/v2.x`, these overrides are replaced by that branch's inherited `workarounds:javaLTSVersions` rules, losing security-tag handling and filtering out Java 27. Renovate's [current default-branch implementation resolves branch presets before merging over main](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/34d4f5ee1e339cb0a1d690b48fb4df963238fc41/lib/workers/repository/process/index.ts#L141-L147), so the maintenance rules run after these additions. Apply both overrides after the preset on maintenance too, or have both branches consume a shared preset, and revise the claim that no branch-specific follow-up is needed.

[Config] This suppresses ordinary build-only updates: `21.0.13_9-jdk` and `21.0.13_10-jdk` both parse as `[21, 0, 13]`. Renovate's [regex parser on its current default branch](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/34d4f5ee1e339cb0a1d690b48fb4df963238fc41/lib/modules/versioning/regex/index.ts#L66-L71) only includes `revision` when `build` is present, but this rule leaves `build` absent for ordinary tags. Use normalization or a versioning strategy that retains the underscore build number for both tag shapes and treats an absent security component as zero; cover build-only updates and security-to-next-patch ordering.

replies.body: Fixed in 5236eb66b9f2. The rule compares the underscore build number numerically even when the security component is absent, so `21.0.13_9-jdk` can advance to `21.0.13_10-jdk`.

Applied in `5236eb66`. Renovate 44.253.4 orders ordinary build increments, the security release, and the next patch correctly; both existing `27_35` pins can advance to compatible patched tags without changing the pins. This cannot take effect on `maintenance/v2.x` from main alone: backport both Temurin package rules in `.github/renovate.json5` there, after its resolved `workarounds:javaLTSVersions` rules, preserving the maintenance-only formatter restriction.
